remarks: This cozy 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo is perfect for those who value comfort and convenience. The bedroom offers plenty of space and a generous closet for all your storage needs. Step outside to your private balcony - the perfect spot for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Inside, enjoy the ease of an in-unit washer/dryer hookup and cool AC for those warm summer days.  Say goodbye to extra bills - heat, hot water, flood insurance, security cameras, grill area, and an on-site super are all included in the common charges. Plus, this pet-friendly community offers plenty of parking and extra storage space for all your essentials.  Candlelight Terrace isn't just a place to live - it's a lifestyle. Picture yourself lounging by the in-ground pool, grilling with friends, or strolling through lush gardens along the scenic Rippowam River. With ample visitor parking and all of downtown Stamford just minutes away, you're never far from fun, shopping, or dining.  Ready to make this charming condo your new home? Let's make it happen!
